newsitem.title: USA: USA Truck sees $71.4 mln cap spending for '97-'98.
newsitem.headline: USA Truck sees $71.4 mln cap spending for '97-'98.

text.p: USA Truck Inc said Monday it plans to spend $71.4 million in capital expenditures for 1997 and 1998.
In a quarterly financial report to the Securities and Exchange Commission, USA Truck said that, of the total, it has spent some $18.8 million through July 25.
It said that, as of that date, it was committed to spend $19.8 million for revenue equipment for the rest of 1997 and $32.1 million for revenue equipment in 1998.

USA Truck is a medium haul, common and contract carrier specializing in truckload quantities of general commodities. The company operates in the 48 contiguous states and in the Canadian provinces of Ontario and Quebec.
